title: Social Caption: Evaluating Social Understanding in Multimodal Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.14569v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Social understanding abilities are crucial for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to interpret human social interactions. We introduce SOCIAL CAPTION, a framework grounded in interaction theory to evaluate social understanding abilities of MLLMs along three dimensions: Social Inference (SI), the ability to make accurate inferences about interactions; Holistic Social Analysis (HSA), the ability to generate comprehensive descriptions of interactions; Directed Social Analysis (DSA), the ability to generate relevant information from interactions. We analyze factors influencing model performance in social understanding, such as scale, architectural design, and spoken context. Experiments with MLLM judges demonstrate a path towards scaling automated evaluation of multimodal social understanding.

translated_title: Social Caption：评估多模态模型中的社会理解能力
translated_abstract: 社会理解能力对于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）解读人类社会互动至关重要。我们提出了SOCIAL CAPTION，这是一个基于互动理论的框架，用于从三个维度评估MLLM的社会理解能力：社会推断，即对互动做出准确推断的能力；整体社会分析，即对互动生成全面描述的能力；定向社会分析，即从互动中提取相关信息的能力。我们分析了影响模型社会理解表现的因素，例如模型规模、架构设计和口语语境。使用MLLM作为评判者的实验展示了扩展多模态社会理解自动化评估的可行路径。
tldr: 本文提出了基于互动理论的SOCIAL CAPTION评估框架，从社会推断、整体社会分析和定向社会分析三个维度衡量多模态大语言模型的社会理解能力，并通过MLLM评判实验展示了自动化评估规模化扩展的路径。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SOCIAL CAPTION, an interaction-theory-grounded framework that evaluates social understanding in multimodal LLMs across three dimensions—Social Inference, Holistic Social Analysis, and Directed Social Analysis—and demonstrates a path toward scaling automated evaluation using MLLM judges.
